reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin that changes backgrounds, decorative styling, character artwork, rotation behavior, and related local interface settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 GirlsBangCry 风格的背景、角色立绘轮播、装饰元素和可配置图片面板。
summaries.en: A GirlsBangCry-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with custom backgrounds, rotating character artwork, decorative interface elements, and configurable image panels.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI appearance and layout
Displays rotating character artwork and backgrounds
Accepts custom portrait and background image uploads
Persists interface settings and uploaded images in localStorage
